title: About Machine Solutions
text: Machine Solutions provides advanced equipment and services for the medical device, biopharmaceutical, and blood- and plasma-collection industries. Founded in 1999 in Flagstaff, Arizona and partnered with BW Forsyth Partners in 2011. Brand promise: Engineered Excellence, built on three pillars: Precision, Process and People. A dedicated aftermarket team provides technical service and process support.

title: Machine Solutions brands
text: The Machine Solutions family includes: MSI (Flagstaff, AZ) - balloon pleating/folding, catheter lamination, thermal and laser bonding, stent crimping and loading, marker band swaging, heart valve crimping, mandrel straightening, radial force and catheter testing. Vante (Tucson, AZ) - catheter tipping, plastic tube bonding, flaring and flanging, mandrel manufacturing. PlasticWeld Systems (Newfane, NY) - catheter tipping, hole forming and thermoplastic welding. Steeger USA (Inman, SC) - fine-wire medical braiding, coiling and stranding, with an R&D braiding lab. BW-TEC (Hori, Switzerland) - balloon forming, tube necking, hydrophilic coating and balloon catheter systems. Crescent Design (Flagstaff, AZ) - hydraulic burst and leak testers (HBLT). Beahm Designs (Flagstaff, AZ) - hot air bonders and hot boxes. Intec Automation (Rochester, NH) - custom automation. SEBRA (Tucson, AZ) - RF tube sealing for biopharmaceutical, blood and plasma applications. Alpine Laser (Bloomington, MN) - laser cutting. Vela Technologies (San Diego, CA) - UV adhesive curing and bonding.

title: Machine Solutions product range
text: Solution groups: Automation Solutions; Balloon Catheter Solutions; Braided Shaft & Lamination Solutions; Catheter Testing Solutions (ISO 10555); Catheter Tipping Solutions; Stent Crimping Solutions; Tube Bonding Solutions; plus Pre-Owned Equipment. Capabilities include adhesive bonding and UV curing, custom automation, balloon forming (stretch blow molding), balloon pleating and folding including drug-coated balloons, RF biopharmaceutical tube sealing, catheter braiding with wire as small as 0.0005 inch, catheter hole forming (drilling, punching, skiving), catheter lamination (reflow of polymers into braided shafts), catheter performance testing (trackability, torquability, pushability), catheter tipping (open, closed and soft tips, flash free), heart valve crimping, hot air bonding, hydraulic burst and leak testing, hydrophilic coating, CO2 laser bonding and welding, laser cutting, mandrel manufacturing and straightening, marker band swaging, plastic tube bonding (butt welds, lap welds, braid to non-braid joints), tube flaring and flanging, radial force testing (ASTM-referenced Segmented Head Apparatus), stent crimping including drug-coated stents, stent loading of long flexible nitinol stents, stent securement testing (ASTM F2394), tube cutting, and wire stranders and coilers.

title: Process Development Labs
text: Machine Solutions Process Development Labs (PDLs) host customer teams for equipment demonstrations, first article samples, tooling design help and applications assistance. A Brooklyn Park, Minnesota applications lab and showroom focuses on catheter braiding and design. Steeger USA's R&D lab has 8 to 96 carrier braiders for samples and trials before purchase. To schedule lab time, email sales@machinesolutions.com.
